local_policy.override: SOLR_GATE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be set to a finite positive integer for an intentionally longer command, with rationale in the gate command plan; SOLR_GATE_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS may set a positive heartbeat interval.
local_policy.timeout_result: Terminate the child process group (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after the grace period) and return 124; record as incomplete, never as a pass. Existing resource floors remain in force.

scope: Local phone-agent-2 execution only. The recommendation is not a claim that other board tasks are stuck or that the board has a broad liveness problem.
suggestion: For the local phone-agent-2 Solr gate-running process, require guarded commands to have a finite wall-clock ceiling, periodic runner heartbeat logs, process-group termination on timeout, and an incomplete/124 result. Record any longer-than-default timeout rationale in that gate plan. Keep this recommendation host-local; do not generalize it to other board tasks.
summary: Added finite runtime and heartbeat safeguards to phone-agent-2 local gate runners and documented their use.
trigger: The owner reported that PR #5333 baseline Bats case 3 waited about 79 minutes on curl to the local node-role endpoint and was stopped incomplete. That report motivates a local runner safeguard only; no #5333 source, gate, report, receipt, or release record was changed.
validation: Both runner sources passed Python compile() syntax validation.
